about: AIOS catch-up list: what existing installs need from newer installers. Run by catchup.py from the start hook. Same file in aios and aios-es. Check exit codes: 0 present, 1 missing, 2 not for this Mac. Rule (RELEASE-CERT.md): every installer change that existing clients also need ships here in the same release.

check: TS=/opt/homebrew/bin/tesseract; [[ -x $TS ]] || TS=/usr/local/bin/tesseract; [[ -x $TS ]] || exit 2; L=$("$TS" --list-langs 2>/dev/null) || exit 3; print -r -- "$L" | grep -qx spa && exit 0 || exit 1
fix: TS=/opt/homebrew/bin/tesseract; [[ -x $TS ]] || TS=/usr/local/bin/tesseract; TD=$("$TS" --list-langs 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*in "\(.*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); [[ -d $TD ]] || exit 1; curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 240 -o "$TD/spa.traineddata.part" https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/raw/main/spa.traineddata && mv "$TD/spa.traineddata.part" "$TD/spa.traineddata"

msg.en: Added the Spanish data for reading scanned documents (tesseract spa), so accents come out right.
msg.es: Se agregaron los datos en español para leer documentos escaneados (tesseract, español), así los acentos salen bien.
